$comment: Machine-readable list of every skill and plugin in this setup. Used by install.sh and by the glad-personal skill. Third-party entries are references to their original authors' repositories — nothing here is copied from them.

own.name: glad-frontend
own.summary: Backend-ready frontend data architecture: repository pattern, swappable mock/real data, real loading/error/empty states.

own.name: production-readiness
own.summary: Evidence-backed production readiness audit with a hard verdict (NOT READY / READY WITH CONDITIONS / READY).

own.name: glad-personal
own.summary: This manifest as a skill: provisions a new machine with the skills and plugins below and sets up the global CLAUDE.md.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.summary: Full design workflow: shape, critique, audit, polish and harden interfaces.
skills.notes: Runs a bundled binary launcher (`impeccable context`) once per session.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.summary: Official Anthropic design principles that avoid the generic AI look.

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.summary: Official Vercel accessibility and UX compliance review.
skills.notes: Fetches the live rules document when it runs.

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.summary: Local searchable design database (palettes, font pairings, icons, GSAP presets, charts) covering 22 stacks.
skills.notes: Queried through a bundled Python script; no network calls. Trust caveat: the author account was created the same day as the repo (2025-11-30) — installed after a clean content review.

skills.name: redesign-existing-projects
skills.summary: Audits and upgrades an existing site without breaking functionality.
skills.notes: Only 3 of the 13 skills in this repo are used; install with --skill, never the bare repo.

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.summary: Image-generation-first website build workflow.
skills.notes: Mostly inert unless an image-generation tool is available in the session.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.summary: About 70 React and Next.js performance rules from Vercel.

skills.name: backend-patterns
skills.summary: API, repository, caching and auth patterns for Node, Express and Next.js.

skills.name: use-railway
skills.summary: Official Railway skill: deploys, services, variables, logs, metrics, recovery.

skills.name: tdd
skills.summary: Red-green-refactor test-driven development.
skills.notes: Overlaps with superpowers' test-driven-development; both kept on purpose.

skills.name: grilling
skills.summary: Stress-tests a plan or decision by grilling you about it.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.summary: Manual alias that forwards to grilling.

skills.name: full-output-enforcement
skills.summary: Stops truncated or placeholder code in answers.

skills.name: caveman
skills.summary: Ultra-brief answer mode to save tokens.
skills.notes: Install only the caveman skill — not its sibling skills or the @caveman-ai/cli proxy.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.summary: Searches the skills directory for skills that fit a task.
skills.notes: Installed with the skills CLI itself; predates the vetting process.

skills.name: dsr
skills.summary: Fallback release infrastructure when GitHub Actions is throttled.
skills.notes: Drives the dsr command-line tool; install the tool from the repo for it to do anything.

skills.name: rch
skills.summary: Offloads cargo/gcc/bun builds to remote workers.
skills.notes: Drives the rch command-line tool; install the tool from the repo for it to do anything.

skills.name: sbh
skills.summary: Disk-pressure defense: ballast files, cleanup, emergency mode.
skills.notes: Drives the sbh command-line tool; install the tool from the repo for it to do anything.

skills.name: casr
skills.summary: Converts and resumes sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other agents.
skills.notes: Not in the skills directory: its own installer downloads a compiled binary and writes the skill. Read the installer first.

skills.name: process-triage
skills.summary: Finds runaway processes and suggests safe fixes (the pt command).
skills.notes: Not in the skills directory: its own installer downloads a compiled binary and writes the skill. Read the installer first.

skills.name: graphify
skills.install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install
skills.summary: Turns code, docs, papers and media into a queryable knowledge graph (/graphify).
skills.notes: Python package; `graphify install` registers the skill. Use `pipx install graphifyy` if uv isn't available.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.summary: Process skills: brainstorming, writing and executing plans, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, verification, writing skills.
plugins.notes: Includes using-superpowers, which makes the agent check skills before every response — an accepted behaviour change. Auto-updates.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.summary: Vercel platform skills: deploys, env vars, Next.js, AI SDK, functions, storage, firewall.

declined.name: browser-use
declined.reason: Real browser control (clicks, forms, cookies/sessions); flagged Med Risk by the installer's own Snyk scan; removed after installing.

declined.name: playwright-cli
declined.reason: Same real-browser-control risk category; declined before installing, including its native installer path.

notProvisioned.name: synced
notProvisioned.reason: Claude Code's own cache of the built-in Anthropic skills (anthropic-skills:*). Host-managed — never copy it.
